svg.title: Hadamard 4x4 cross-mix detail
svg.desc: Four chain outputs enter a Walsh-Hadamard matrix mix. Every output feeds every input with either an additive or subtractive contribution, shown as warm and cool lines. The four mixed results feed back into the chain inputs.
svg.text: each output fans to all four mix sums — + adds, − subtracts
all four sums multiplied by 0.5 — preserves energy, prevents gain buildup
Every chain now contains a decorrelated blend of all four chains.
No chain ever repeats the same signal twice — this is what creates density without discrete echoes.
